name: GitSave
description: Back up your Git repositories on a schedule

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The SQLite database (GitSave.db) with your schedules, history and saved access tokens, plus .jwt_secret and .encryption_secret, this install's own keys made on first start. Back this folder up; saved tokens can't be read without .encryption_secret.

paths.name: Backups
paths.description: The backups: one folder per schedule with a full mirror clone of the repository for each run.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: GitSave web app, published on host as 6181

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.
